questions.question: Choose the correct sentence with the past perfect tense.
options: She had finished her homework before the bell rang.
She finishes her homework before the bell rang.
She has finished her homework before the bell rang.
She was finishing her homework before the bell rang.
questions.answer: She had finished her homework before the bell rang.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?
options: I have been to Paris last year.
I have been to Paris since two years.
I have been to Paris for two years.
I have been to Paris in two years.
questions.answer: I have been to Paris since two years.

questions.question: Select the correct comparative form.
options: My brother is tall than me.
My brother is taller than I.
My brother is taller than me.
My brother is taller than mine.
questions.answer: My brother is taller than me.

questions.question: Which conditional sentence is correctly formed?
options: If it rains, the match will be postponed.
If it rains, the match would be postponed.
If it rains, the match will be postponed.
If it rains, the match has been postponed.
questions.answer: If it rains, the match will be postponed.

questions.question: Choose the correct modal verb for the sentence: 'You should not leave the house until the storm is over.'
options: You must not leave the house until the storm is over.
You should not leave the house until the storm is over.
You can not leave the house until the storm is over.
You may not leave the house until the storm is over.
questions.answer: You must not leave the house until the storm is over.

questions.question: Select the correct form (gerund or infinitive) to complete the sentence: 'He prefers _____ in the garden rather than watching TV.'
options: to sit
sitting
sat
sit

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a linker?
options: The film was interesting, but the ending was disappointing.
The film was interesting, and the ending was disappointing.
The film was interesting, so the ending was disappointing.
The film was interesting, because the ending was disappointing.
questions.answer: The film was interesting, but the ending was disappointing.

questions.question: Choose the best word to complete the sentence: 'The museum is ____ crowded on Tuesdays.'
options: less
more
fewer
little

questions.question: Select the correct word to complete the sentence: 'The teacher asked the students to _____ their answers before handing in.'
options: confirm
verify
check
examine

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the word 'despite'?
options: Despite the rain, the match was played.
Despite the rain, the match was playeded.
Despite the rain, the match was played.
Despite the rain, the match was played.
questions.answer: Despite the rain, the match was played.
